Commentary.Commentary: A mentally and physically derailed England side have a target of 628 in front of them. They have a little more that 2 days to achieve it. Can they do so? I do not think they can, they are probably batted out of the game and a miracle would be needed even if they are to save this one. Windies on the other hand, will try and repeat their performance of the first innings. Even if they bowl half as good as they did, they could wrap up the game tomorrow itself. Will they once again blow away the batting line-up of the English side or will there be a fight back. Stay tuned to find out.

The Windies entered this innings already having a big lead of 212. Their openers got them off to a good start once again but wickets from Moeen Ali and Ben Stokes saw them collapse from 60 for 1 to 61 for 5. England did sniff a chance of fighting back but then Hetmyer along with Hope steadied the ship with a 59-run stand and then Dowrich and Holder batted the away side out with the best 7th wicket stand for the Windies against England. The keeper-batsman scored an unbeaten ton and the skipper notched an unbeaten 200.

WINDIES HAVE FINALLY DECLARED! Jason Holder and Shane Dowrich walk off to a huge ovation by the crowd here, by their teammates and they deserve every bit of it. this innings was all about them. Their mammoth 295-run stand has set a daunting total for the visitors.

We are back for the final session! The English players again make their way out to the middle. Shane Dowrich and Jason Holder will resume their innings. Don't think they will be batting for long. We will find out though as Moeen Ali continues.
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

Another wicket-less session for England. Windies now lead by 561. Not sure how much more will they score before declaring. However one feels that they are waiting for Shane Dowrich's ton. Time will tell. Join us in a while for the third and final session of Day 3.

We are back for the post lunch session. Windies skipper Jason Holder and Shane Dowrich will continue their innings. Adil Rashid to bowl the first over after Lunch.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

I don't think I need to mention whose session this is! The Windies have strengthened their grip on this game by extending their lead to one short of 450. Both Holder and Dowrich have got to their half ton and have added a 100-plus run stand between the two. They are still not done and one would expect them to come out and look for some quick runs after the break. Also, it will be interesting to see when will the Windies declare. Maybe when they reach 500? Time will tell. Do join us for the second session in a while.

Another length delivery, Holder guides it to point for a single.
FOUR! Holder is on the charge here! His fourth boundary in the last 7 balls he has faced. Short and it sits up to be hit. Holder pulls it through backward square leg and it races away.
This one shapes back in from outside off, Dowrich looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket and the batsmen run a leg bye.
No he cannot. Flighted on off, Holder decides to take the foot off the gas and defends that one. 13 runs off that Moeen Ali over.

FOUR!! Three boundaries in three consecutive balls. Jason Holder is taking the attack to the off spinner. Slow and flighted around off, Holder this time lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Can he score 4 in 4?
FOUR! Two in two. Once again it is tossed up and overpitched around off, Holder drives it again in the same region and gets exactly the same result.

FOUR! Tossed up on off, Holder gets his front foot in line and brilliantly drives it through covers for a boundary. Brings up the 50 run stand between these two. They are taking away any slight hope England have from this game.
Flighted around off, Dowrich defends it with soft hands and takes a single.
Tossed up on middle, Shane blocks it off his front foot.
Full around off,the ball jags back in and Jason blocks it to see off the over.
Outside off, once again Holder shoulders arms to it.
Full outside off, Jason shoulders arms to it. The ball swings inwards after it goes past the stumps.
Shorter in length, Dowrich pulls it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full outside off, Shane decides to let that one go.
Sam Curran is introduced in the attack. He starts with a full length delivery on off, Dowrich watchfully defends it.
Once again full outside off, Holder is not going to go chasing at that one, so he leaves it.
Full and straight outside off, Jason shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Back of a length on middle and leg, Holder flicks it fine on the leg side, wide of Moeen Ali in the deep. The ball races away to the fence.
Pull his length back this time and bowls it outside off, Holder is not tempted to play that one and lets it go.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Dowrich flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Full on off, Dowrich defends it off his front foot.
FOUR! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Holder just flicks it fine towards fine leg and the ball races away to the fence. Poor delivery from Stokes to finish off the over.
Good length delivery on middle and off, the ball comes in after pitching. Jason tries to defend but gets hit on the mid riff region.
Shorter in length, Holder gets on his back foot and keeps it down.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Holder defends it from the crease.
Full on off, Jason drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length around off, Holder blocks it.
Lands it on a length around off, Dowrich is solid in defense.
Another delivery outside off, no need to play at those.
FOUR! EDGY BOUNDARY! Full and around off, it shapes away. Dowrich lunges and tries to defend but it goes off the outer half through the slip cordon and it races to the fence.
Outside off, it is left alone.
On the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
On the fuller side, it is driven to covers. Holder's cover drives are delightful, he is struggling to find the gaps though.
Another play and a miss! Dowrich is once again guilty of playing at a ball which he need not. Good length and outside off, Dowrich hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Once again Stokes beats the outside edge. Once again he angles it in first and then gets it to leave the batsman. Dowrich again plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket and takes another run.
Another short of a length delivery on middle, Dowrich this time clips it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On the shorter side, it is tucked around the corner for a single.
Stokes is guilty of overstepping once again. He bowls it short and outside off, Holder evades.
Angles it into the batsman, it is worked through square leg for a single.
Good leave! Slightly outside off, it is left alone.
FOUR! In the gap and you need not run for those! Full and on off, Holder just leans into it and strokes it through covers. No stopping those.
Good length on off, this one comes back in a touch. Holder keeps it out.
Just behind a length and outside off, Holder stays rooted to his crease and pushes it to covers. Three balls in a row he is unable to find the gap.
Good length again, Holder once again strokes ti crisply but finds the man at covers.
Once again goes full on off, Holder times it nicely but finds the man at covers.
Good delivery this! He first slants it into the off pole, it pitches and then moves away. Dowrich looks to defend but is beaten by the away movement.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Another short one outside off, Holder plays inside the line and gets beaten.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Nicely pulled! He gets on top of the bounce and hits it all along the ground towards deep square leg. A single taken.
Another play and a miss! However, this could have been left. Good length ball a little too wide outside off. Dowrich reaches out for it and looks to push it through the off side. He gets beaten.
Another defensive stroke to end the over.
Good length on off, Holder lunges and keeps it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish on off, Holder strokes it to mid off.
BEATEN! Once again gets the ball to move away from a length on off, Holder looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary! A little but of away movement from the batsman. It is on a fuller length on off, Holder looks to drive but it goes off the outer half towards point. Bairstow there slides and lets it go through. The cover fielder runs behind it, slides but can't stop the boundary. The lead has now crossed 350.
Finishes the over with a half volley outside off, left alone.
Leading edge but safe. Back of a length on middle, Holder tries to flick but closes the face of his bat a little early. It goes off the outer half towards point for a single.
Fullish and on middle, it is stroked towards mid on for a single.
A little too straight, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Angles it on off, Holder gets behind the line and keeps it out towards cover for a run.
Angles this one into the batter and then gets it to leave him. Holder defends inside the line and gets beaten.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another good length delivery on off, the batsman goes back and blocks it.
Good length on off, Dowrich gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Fuller in length on off, it is stroked to covers.
Hits the length hard and bowls it on off, defended.
On a length and around off, it is kept out.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Shoritsh and outside off again, Holder this time plays inside the line and lets it be.
First good delivery and it goes past the outside off. On a length and around off, it pitches and straightens. Holder looks to defend but is beaten.
Oversteps now and the line is once again on the pads, it is clipped around the corner for a single.
Down the leg side, Dowrich misses the flick. Hasn't got it right here Ben Stokes.
Gets his line right this time and lands it around off, blocked.
He too strats off with a loosener which is way down the leg side, Dowrich lets it be. The keeper makes  a half stop, no extra run conceded though.
Ben Stokes to bowl from the other end.
A little too straight this time, it is worked to the man at mid-wicket. End of a good first over for the Windies.
On the shorter side this time, Holder guides it to gully, thinks of a run but is sent back rightly by his partner.
Around off this time, it is guided through point for a run. No swing on offer for Anderson till now.
Another one on the hips, Holder this time works it through square leg and a single is taken.
On the shorter side, it is tucked around the corner for a single. First run for Dowrich today.
A loosener to start off with, gentle delivery on off, it is on a length. Holder taps it towards covers and takes a run.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out comm the England players along with the umpires. Jason Holder and Shane Dowrich will continue their innings. The former will be on strike and he will be facing James Anderson. Here we go...

The visitors on the other hand, need to pick the remaining wickets as quickly as possible and then try and bat well on a wicket which has started to play tricks. An interesting day awaits. Welcome to the coverage.

If you ever thought we would enter Day 3 with the hosts comfortably ahead in the game, you should probably buy a lottery ticket. Their lead is close to 350 and another 50 runs or so will probably see them bat the visitors out of the game.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The hosts now have their captain and a well-set batsman out there. One more partnership will probably see them bat England out of the game. The visitors on the other hand, need to take the remaining wickets quickly if they are to have a chance here. Will the Windies continue their dominance or will the away side fight back? Join us on Day 3 to find out at 1000 local (1400 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Windies in their second innings, once again got off to a good start as their openers stitched a fifty-run stand. Just as they seemed like they were running away with the game a collapse is what we witnessed. From 60 for 1 they derailed to 61 for 5. England at that time did sense an opening but Hetmyer and Dowrich counter-attacked. The two added a 50-plus run stand and took the lead above 300. The former perished but one would believe the partnership did the damage.

The day however, began with England bundling out the hosts for below 300 with Hetmyer being the top scorer. For England, Anderson and Stokes took one each today. The former finished with a 5-fer whereas the latter with a 4-wicket haul. However, the Windies blew away the English batters courtesy an outstanding spell by Roach. He took 5 and ensured the Windies take a massive lead.
What a day of Test cricket did we witness! At the end of it, it is the hosts who are in the driver's seat here. They have a lead of one short of 340 and still 4 wickets in hand.

Full and wide outside off, Holder drives is square on the off side. The fielder there misfields, he though recovers well, runs behind the ball and saves a run for his side. The umpire do go upstairs to check and replays show that he has done well. The players in the meantime have already started walking back to the pavilion as IT IS STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Outside off, left alone.

A huge appeal but not given! Going down leg. Full and tailing back in on middle, Holder looks to flick but misses to get hit on the back pad. A huge appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. The fielder at slip collects the ball and hits the stumps at the keeper's end. Holder is in though.
A good length ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! A gift for Holder on the very first ball. A full toss outside off, it still has to be put away and Holder does exactly that as he guides it through backward point for a boundary.

OUT! They have got a wicket! England have broken the 59-run stand. Sam Curran picks up his first of the game. A length ball on middle and slightly shaping away. Hetmyer tries to drive on the up but gets an outside edge and the ball carries to Buttler who takes a good, low catch. This should lift the shoulders of England that were dropping a bit. Windies are effectively 332/6. Can they get one more before Stumps?
Pulled hard but too close to the fielder at deep mid-wicket, only a run. So a better second over by Rashid.
The googly and it has been picked again, Dowrich flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Whipped with the turn towards wide long on for a single.
Short and outside off, it is hit to the man at sweeper cover for a single.
The slider there, it is pushed to mid on.
Slower and outside off, turning away. Dowrich lets it be.
Full and wide outside off, Hetmyer reaches out for it but ends up mistiming it to covers.
Way too wide outside off to make the batsman play.
On the shorter side, Hetmyer guides it to point. Then practices the pull shot. Don't think that shot was on though.
Close! A good leave in the end! An off cutter outside off, Hetmyer leaves it, it does come in but not enough.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length on off, Dowrich drops it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Sam Curran is back on now.
FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away! 13 from the over, expensive start by Rashid. Short and wide outside off, SH slaps it through covers and the ball races away.

On the shorter side, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. 50-run stand is up between the two and it has come at a very good pace. A good counter-attacking stand and a vital one as when the two joined association, the Windies were in a spot of bother.
The googly now, Hetmyer picks it and punches it through covers for a run.

SIX! Stand and deliver stuff! Right in his arc this one. Full and turning back in. Hetmyer hits it with the turn so the risk is minimum. The connection is outstanding, it sails into the mid-wicket stand. Lead crosses 320 now.
Slightly shorter and quicker, it is punched down to long on for a single.
Tosses it up on middle, Dowrich defends it off the inner half. Good start that by the leggie.
Adil Rashid to bowl some leg spin now.
Another bouncer down the leg side, Hetmyer easily ducks under it. Getting too predictable now is Stokes. Time for a change? Maybe.
Continues with the short ball ploy, SH blocks it onto the ground quite easily.
Short and outside off, Hetmyer evades it.
Works it with the agnle through square leg for a single.
Shortish again on the body, it is tucked towards leg gully.
Shorter in length, Dowrich hops and defends it onto the ground.
Nice shot down the ground by Dowrich. Long on runs to his left and keeps it to one.
100 up for the Windies as Hetmyer eases this down to long on for a single. The lead is now 312 and the partnership is 39.
Short and outside off, Dowrich cuts it through point. Curran in the deep runs to his left and does well to keep it in place. Three taken for the batsmen.
Flatter and it turns back into the batter, Dowrich works it towards short leg.
He plays these strokes really nicely! Comes down the track again and lofts it over covers for a run.
Flatter and on the pads, Hetmyer nudges it away.
Short of a length on the leg side to end the over, fended down fine on the leg side. No run though.
Another one banged in short of a length. Really good effort here from Stokes. It is his 10th over on the trot. Have to give it to man for commitment. Not easy in the sun.
The batsman watches this bouncer go way above his head.
A helmet coming in. Buttler going under the lid on the off side.
A bouncer on middle, SD fends this off, not very comfortably though.
Bouncer down the leg side, Shane jumps as he lets this ball go.
What else but of a short of a length? Dowrich climbs on top of the ball and keeps it down.
Good placement from Hetmyer. A fuller one outside off, driven wide of long off and an easy couple is picked up.
Fuller one on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Hetmyer throws everything he has on that one as he tried to slog it over deep mid-wicket. The ball misses the bat but goes off the keeper and rolls fine on the leg side for a bye.
Slower this time outside off on a short length, Hetmyer hangs back and defends it.
Bowls this full and quick at the pads, flicked away to short fine leg who makes a tumbling stop.
Flatter ball that is going down with the angle, Hetmyer gets rapped on the pad and the ball lobs towards short leg. A small appeal but nothing more.
Another short ball to end the over but it is kept down by the wicket-keeper batsman.
Bounce is the template but currently Dowrich is playing it pretty well.
Another bumper from Stokes, defended after getting on top of the bounce by Shane.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for Dowrich.
Short of a length ball on middle and off, Shimron fends it off towards the off side for a single to the point region.
Fuller length ball on the pads, flicked away to deep fine leg for a single.
Another ball on middle that is dead-batted into the ground.
A front foot defense to this flatter one on middle.
Well down the leg side and Hetmyer tries to flick it but misses his connection.
Flatter one on middle, Shane plays a cross batted shot down to long on for a single.
Lands this one on middle and it spins way down the leg side. Left alone by the batsman.
Dowrich has played that off the front foot and onto the ground.
Five on the trot! Brilliant bowling from Stokes and equally smart by Hetmyer to leave all of these alone and not play at them. It could be Stokes' last over of this spell.
Four on a trot, this bouncer is down leg side though. Left alone.
Trying to bounce him out Stokes here. Hetmyer sways out of the way once more.
Another bumper and SH lets it go.
Bouncer! A reply from Stokes as he goes for the short pitched one to the left-hander. Shimron ducks under it and lets it go.

FOUR! 'Not many do that to Ben Stokes' says Nasser Hussain on air, and he is right. No one treats the all-rounder with that kind of disdain. A fuller length ball on middle bowled with effort and Hetmyer clears his front leg and smashes it back over mid on for a boundary. This is lovely counter-attacking cricket from Windies. The lead is now 300.
SD comes ahead and dead-bats this one to end the over.
This one is defended off the back foot by the batsman.

SIX! Another maximum, the second of this over. 4 boundaries in the last 6 balls. Brilliant shot this, stand and deliver stuff from Dowrich. A flatter one outside off, Shane picks it up and deposits it over the long on fence. The lead is nearing 300.
Flatter ball on the pads this time, SH comes down the ground and then flicks it away for a single to deep square leg.
Fired in quick and full on middle, dug out by Shimron.

SIX! Lifted handsomely over long off! That is 14 off the last 3 balls. This one is flighted outside off and Hetmyer doesn't need a second invite to smash this over the fence for a maximum, the first of this innings.
FOUR! Two in two! On the pads and easily flicked away to the rope for a boundary to deep square leg. Windies will love the runs that are getting added.
FOUR! Every run is vital here and England will be hurt by this boundary. A short length ball outside off, Dowrich is on his toes as he pulls this away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
The batsman has stood up on his toes to defend that one.
Well down leg side now and Shane tries to flick but does not get bat on ball.
Short of a length one on middle stump, Dowrich gets on top of the bounce and fends the ball down.
Bowls this on a length outside off, defended with soft hands by Dowrich.
Fired in at the middle stump, Hetmyer digs it out by bringing his bat down in time. An appeal from Ali but nothing more to it.
SH slightly comes ahead and dead-bats this ball.
Shimron clears his front leg and lifts this over extra cover for a couple of runs. Gets off the mark with the same shot.
On the pads and flicked away towards the square leg fielder.
A flatter and quicker one on middle, Hetmyer comes ahead to defend but gets a thick inside edge towards short leg on the bounce.
Sharp turn there but Hetmyer prods ahead and pads it away.
Left alone outside off to end the over. Another successful one for England.
Shane is on his toes as he flicks this one towards short fine leg.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A short of a length ball, Dowrich defends it towards the off side on his back foot.
Shane Dowrich walks in at number 7.

OUT! Stokes has made up for him making his team lose a review here. Jennings has taken this at short leg. Hope is the one to go and that is the 17th wicket to fall today. Windies have slipped from 60/1 to 61/5. 4 wickets for 1 run. Unbelievable stuff this. A length ball on off stump, jags in a bit and Hope who was playing outside the line of the ball, tries to adjust but can only get an inside edge that goes onto the pads and then to Jennings at short leg. A very sharp catch that and England are right back in the game here surely!
A length ball outside off, Hope defends it off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge and England now have lost both their reviews. Moeen Ali tosses it up around off, it pitches turns and bounce a touch extra. Goes agonizingly close past the gloves. Foakes takes it and then there is an appeal. Stokes is pleading as he feels it is out. The umpire though shakes his head. Stokes wants this to be reviewed and Root does so. Replays roll in and it shows no spike as the ball passes the glove.

Review time. Stokes seems to have heard something and has forced his captain to take this one upstairs. There is a smile on Hetmyer's face though. Did not seem like there was anything on it. Replays awaited...
Flatter and outside off, Hetmyer leaves it along.
Shimron Hetmyer comes in at 6, replacing Chase.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Two in the over for Ali and Chase bags a duck. This is tossed up outside off, it pitches and goes straight on. Chase defends for the non-existent turn. The ball takes the outside edge and goes into the big hands of Ben Stokes. A good passage of play for England this.
Fuller and on middle, it is worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
Roston Chase walks in at number 5.

OUT! Bravo fails in the second innings as well. You just can't keep Stokes out of the game, pockets an easy catch at slip with his bucket hands. A good one with some drift bowled on off stump line, Darren is ahead to defend. Gets a slight edge that carries to Ben at slip. The nightmare return to Test cricket continues for Bravo. England have three quick ones. Can't have enough of saying this, they still need the wickets to keep coming.
Flatter one on off stump, defended on the front foot by Bravo.
Hits the length hard again, Hope tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards gully.
Good delivery! On a length and around off, pitches and straightens. Hope tries to defend but gets beaten.
A little too straight, it is worked around the corner for a run.
On the shorter side, Bravo evades it.
Darren Bravo is the new man in.

OUT! The Drinks break does the trick for England. A very strange dismissal though and now both the openers are back in the hut. A short delivery by Stokes outside off, it pitches and it might have come slow off the surface. Campbell is way too early into his pull shot. It goes off the toe end towards covers where Jennings takes a dolly. Two wickets in quick succession, they need more here.
On the fuller side, it is flicked through mid-wicket and the batter takes two.

Drinks break. Windies have lost Brathwaite but are surely batting the English out of the game slowly. They lead by 270 now and have all the time in the world. The visitors desperately need a lot of quick wickets. Let's watch what happens in the last passage of play on Day 2...
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Just short! Luck too needs to go Windies' way. A hint of turn there after it pitched on off, Campbell goes back and tries to defend. The ball hits the outside edge and lands just short of the diving Stokes.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another flighted ball on middle, JC lunges and keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, the batter goes back and keeps it out.
Full and on the pads, Campbell flicks it but finds the man at short fine leg.
The batsman plays the pull shot. One run added to the total.
Back of a length on off, it is blocked out.
A full toss on off, Hope strokes it through covers for a couple.
On the pad, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
Loose stroke that! Full and wide outside off, Campbell can probably leave that but he goes after it and gets beaten.
Tosses it up on off, Hope lunges and keeps it out.
Shai Hope walks in at number 3 for the hosts.

OUT! Once again Moeen Ali draws first blood! This was plumb in front! Quicker and flatter on off, it turns back in just a touch. Brathwaite goes back and tries to flick. He misses, it hits him on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Brathwaite once again walks back after getting a start. England need a few more quickly as the Windies are effectively 264 for 1.
On the pads, worked to short fine leg,
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, it is slapped through covers for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
Change of gloves for the openers here.
Fuller on off, it is timed down to long off for a couple. 50-run stand up, once again the openers have provided a good start.
EDGY RUN! Good length around off, Campbell tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards third man for a run.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Another big outswinger on off, kept out.
BEAUTY! This is one starts off from leg stump and then swings away. Campbell tries to defend but gets beaten.
On the fuller side, it is stroked to mid off.
Works it with the turn to short leg.
On middle, it is negotiated easily.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Very full and on middle, it is worked towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it very nicely through square leg for a boundary.
Down the leg side, the batter tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the off pole, Kraigg keeps it out.
Short and on the body, Campbell mistimes his pull through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, it is left alone.
On the shorter side, it is on the body. Kraigg awkwardly pulls it ovre the leg gully and down to fine leg for a run.
On the shorter side, Kraigg stands tall and blocks it out.
Eased through covers for a single.
Another tossed up ball on off, blocked.
Flighted delivery on off, KB lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Fired on middle, it is tucked to short fine leg.
Flatter and on off, it is kept out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Uses his feet but ends up yorking himself. Brathwaite jams it out to mid off.
This is the in-dipper, it is a full toss but on the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but it is missing leg.
Full and on middle, Campbell defends it on the back foot.

In the air... safe! Lucky there the batsman. Stokes immediately makes something happen here. He bowls a well-directed short ball. Capmbell looks to pull but is late on the shot. It hits the top edge and goes over mid off for a couple.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Campbell misses the flick. It brushes the pad and goes to the keeper. He is excited but nothing from the umpire.
On off, defended.
Ben Stokes comes on. Can he produce some magic?
On the stumps yet again, negotiated easily by Kraigg.
Flatter and on off, it is clipped to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, Brathwaite blocks it out.
250 is the lead now! This is swept right off the middle towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Out of here! What a shot that! Sees the flighted ball, takes his leg out of the way and whacks it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Guided towards the third man region for a single. Campbell retains strike.
Short of a length ball on top of middle, a back foot defense ensues.
Flicked away off the pads this time towards square leg by the southpaw for two.
Attempts a yorker, Campbell takes it on the full and opens the face of his bat towards the left of cover for a couple of runs.
Fuller length on the pads, flicked away by the righty to deep square leg for a solitary run.
Length ball on off and coming in with the angle, blunted back down the ground by the batsman.
A good front foot defense by Campbell coming ahead.
Short length ball on middle and leg, flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
Brathwaite gets behind the line of the ball and defend it back down the ground.
Flighted outside off, driven down to long off for a single by the left-hander.
Fuller one outside off, driven to cover.
Full toss on off, Campbell misses out as he hits it straight back to mid off.
Moeen Ali has been called on to bowl now.
Pushed towards the vacant mid off area for a couple of runs by the right-hander.
Shaping in after landing on a length, Brathwaite defends it back towards mid on.
Bouncer! Kraigg ducks under it and lets it go.
Full one again now, KB looks to flick it but gets a leading edge that rolls towards cover.
This one is on a good length and coming in, Kraigg defends it back down the ground.
Around the wicket, Curran gets this one to come in with the angle. Brathwaite looks to flick it away but it takes the inside edge and goes on to the pads.
On the middle stump line, placed towards mid-wicket by Brathwaite as he picks up a single and keeps strike.
Fuller one on the pads, flicked away to deep fine leg for a single.
Similar ball and similar shot played to the same fielder.
Length ball outside off, Campbell works it towards mid-wicket but the fielder dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Good length ball shaping into the left-hander but it is well played by John towards mid on.
Full and some banana swing there on that one, Brathwaite does well to place it between gully and point for a run.
A length ball on off stump, Campbell comes ahead a bit and defends with a straight bat.
Kraigg flicks it off his pads and picks up a single to deep square leg.
Falls short of Stokes at third slip. A genuine edge on this ball on a length on middle and off. It does not carry because Brathwaite played it with really soft hands. Good ball from Curran though.
Shortens the length a bit and bowls it just outside off, KB stands tall and defends this ball.
Left alone outside off this time by Kraigg.
Good fuller length ball on middle and shaping in. Brathwaite digs it out pretty comfortably.
Left alone outside off to end the over. Maiden.
Hurls this one down the leg side but Campbell fails to connect the ball while attempting to glance the ball.
Swings away from the lefty after landing well outside off, left alone by the southpaw. Looks like Anderson slipped a bit there while bowling which made him lose the trajectory.
Bowls this one on top of off stump line, John comes a bit ahead and defends it onto the ground.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump once more.
Well outside off and let be by Campbell this time.
A little too straight, it is clipped around the corner for a single.
On the fuller side, Capmbell looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, it is tucked around the corner for a run,
Back of a length on off, Kraigg stands tall and punches it to mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Brathwaite keeps it out.
Good running! Good cricket all around. It was a good delivery around off, it shapes away a touch. Campbell pushes it towards covers and takes off for a run.
Flicked away this time to square leg wristily for a single.

NOT OUT! Swinging too much and it misses the leg pole. England lose a review too. Length ball on middle and it shapes in beautifully. Campbell is ahead to play it but misses the ball and gets rapped on the pads. Root takes it upstairs after it was called not out. Replays roll on and show that the ball would have missed the stumps. Poor review, done more due to the desperate situation the team is in maybe. Windies won't mind though. Lovely bowling from James but no reward yet.

Review time. Campbell has been rapped in front and there is a loud appeal from the bowler and the fielders. The umpire shakes his head but Root decides to take it upstairs. Looked like it was going down leg to the naked eye...
A length ball on off, defended back down the ground.
Beaten! Another peach. A length one and this just shapes away very slightly and beats the outside edge once more. Too good for any batsman.
Brings this one a bit closer to the off pole and takes it away, John is drawn into a cover drive as he is beaten on the outside due to the swing.
Wayward delivery outside off, left alone by Campbell.

FOUR! 'Shades of Gordon Greenidge' quips Ian Bishop on air. A short of a length delivery on middle, Brathwaite hops on one leg and flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a boundary. Windies and he are into double figures.
The ball is too wide on the off side to force the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR! Lovely shot using the bottom hand. A full, inswinging delivery on middle and it is pushed back down past mid on for a boundary by Brathwaite.
Good length ball on middle and shaping in a tad bit, Kraigg flicks it towards square leg.
Left alone outside off once more by Brathwaite.
Length ball outside off, the ball keeps low and holds its line and goes through to Foakes behind the wicket.
Sam Curran to share the new ball.
Solid defense on the front foot from Campbell towards cover.
A single to follow the boundary. Good batting. Length ball on the pads is pushed towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! The gift is accepted by KB. Short and wide outside off, cut away by Brathwaite for a boundary. First runs of the second innings for Windies.
Good length ball on middle and swinging away a bit, defended back down the ground by Kraigg.
A short of a length delivery on off once more played with soft hands towards point.
Length ball to start off with outside off and swinging away, a late leave from Brathwaite.
